tools.name: country_risk
tools.description: Use when you need the current derived risk state for a single country across selected domains without writing a free-form question. Do not use for bilateral corridors (use corridor_risk) or change attribution (use change_since_last_verified or why_changed). Paid via x402 USDC; never returns raw upst

tools.name: corridor_risk
tools.description: Use when assessing directional cross-border risk from an origin country to a destination country (trade, supply chain, or settlement corridor). Do not use for single-country queries (use country_risk). Paid via x402 USDC; read-only.

tools.name: change_since_last_verified
tools.description: Use when checking what materially changed since the previous published verified state for a country or corridor. Do not use if you only need the current baseline snapshot (use country_risk or three_domain_state) or causal drivers (use why_changed). Paid via x402 USDC.

tools.name: why_changed
tools.description: Use when investigating the specific drivers and causes behind the latest verified risk-state change for a country or corridor. Do not use for current static risk levels (use country_risk) or pre-payment policy gates (use risk_gate_decision_context). Paid via x402 USDC.

tools.name: three_domain_state
tools.description: Use when you want a unified snapshot across all three Geomacro domains (geopolitics, macro/FX, and critical minerals) for a country or corridor. Do not use when filtering to a single domain (use country_risk or a category *_query tool). Paid via x402 USDC.

tools.name: risk_gate_decision_context
tools.description: Use before a treasury, vendor, or agent payment or exposure review to obtain a policy-aware, non-executing Risk Gate decision context (CONTINUE, REDUCE_LIMIT, REQUIRE_APPROVAL, or PAUSE). Do not use for general news summaries. Paid via x402 USDC; execution_authorized is always false.

tools.name: verify_risk_object
tools.description: Use when verifying the Ed25519 signature and integrity of a signed Geomacro Risk Object already in your possession. Free (no payment required) and read-only; verifies cryptographic authenticity only and never authorizes execution.
